notes: hit kinds 0/4: Raptor_HurtAir (o+0x174 bit 2), Raptor_HurtDown (bit 1) or Raptor_HurtStand

name: Raptor_HurtStand
notes: flinches by the hits counted in ext+0x1D, or falls (o+0x170 bit 0, health)

name: Raptor_HurtDown
notes: hit while down: lies still or dies

name: Raptor_Knock
notes: hit kind 1: in the air, down (Raptor_KnockDown) or Raptor_KnockStand

name: Raptor_KnockDown
notes: hit hard while down: lies still or dies

name: Raptor_Blow
notes: hit kind 2: in the air, down or Raptor_BlowStand

name: Raptor_HurtAir
notes: thrown back (kind 3 farthest), lands on its side or dead

name: Raptor_Burn
notes: hit kind 3: killed at once, falls to the floor

name: Raptor_Drown
notes: hit kind 5: when it kills, falls off into the water (quads 0x7032B0/0x7032C0) and goes

name: AOT_Message
notes: AOT kind 2: message at script data +0x14

name: AOT_Wait
notes: AOT kind 9: routine once flag 0xA/+0x19 is the one waited for (G+0xB4A)

name: AOT_Kind10
notes: AOT kind 10: by character, object effects in a ring (Regina) or an effect slot (Dylan)

name: AOT_Kind11
notes: AOT kind 11: one of two messages by flag 8/+0x14

name: Eff_AllocBack
notes: last free object effect slot from the end, cleared

name: ObjEff_Shade
notes: (e, v): colour bytes of the model polygons (+0x68)

name: ObjEff_ThrownMove
notes: spins, moves, falls until below the player

name: ObjEff_Debris
notes: object effect: steps 0x7377EC, freed at +0x50 bit 30

name: ObjEff_DebrisMove
notes: spins, rises then falls until below the player

name: ObjEff_InHandInit
